mathematics.assertion_tested: For ten specified challenge/solution pairs, the shipped Lean 4.36.0 comparison and axiom checks distinguish fixed APCI or RH targets from changed definitions, added premises and unpermitted assumptions; three allowed controls pass those component checks. Direct kernel checks validate the permitted solution exports and the Boolean non-recoverability control.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact Lean propositions and functions on Bool and Unit; the official Mathlib v4.36.0 RiemannHypothesis definition
mathematics.conventions: Separate Lean module environments for challenge and solution; standard permitted axiom names propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice; only explicitly configured definition holes may vary.
inputs: Three original RH answer-slot challenge pairs
A proof that a constant Bool-to-Unit trace cannot decode the identity answer
non_claims: Does not prove or disprove RH.
Does not prove universal Comparator correctness.
Direct component and kernel runs are not sandboxed Comparator acceptance.
An environment failure is not a mathematical rejection.
Mathlib cache and the official Lean distribution are trusted build inputs, pinned here; the entire cache source closure is not rebuilt.
